room_rent.note: Policy wording lists room rent as covered under hospitalisation expenses up to Sum Insured with no stated cap on room category or daily limit.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under hospitalisation expenses up to Sum Insured; no separate sub-limit stated.

copayment.note: No co-payment clause mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.display: OPD, Maternity, Air Ambulance, Organ Donor, Physiotherapy, Recovery benefit sub-limited
sub_limits.note: Hospitalisation SI has no disease-wise sub-limits; however OPD, Maternity, Air Ambulance, Organ Donor, Physiotherapy and Recovery benefit each have separate plan-specific monetary caps.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions 12 months; joint replacement, DNS, congenital internal, Parkinson's, laser eye 24 months.

maternity.note: Inbuilt; limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime; Plan D ₹40,000, Plan E ₹40,000, Plan F ₹40,000; both spouses must be on same policy.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% per claim-free year; max 50% of base SI.

restoration.note: 100% of hospitalisation SI reinstated once per policy period after full exhaustion; only for subsequent unrelated illness claims.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient covered within hospitalisation SI; government hospital required.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance at actuals within hospitalisation SI. Air ambulance: Plan D ₹1,50,000, Plan E ₹2,00,000, Plan F ₹2,50,000.

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, IVF/ART, ectopic pregnancy under maternity (covered under hospitalisation), external appliances, non-medical consumables, refractive error <7.5D
optional_riders: Ancillary Expenses (daily allowance + ICU allowance), Critical Illness cover (15 CIs), Personal Accident cover (Death/PTD/PPD/TTD)
